title: Running Commentary on Torah 53 — Ikkar Ha'Holadah b'Ha
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 53 — עיקר ההולדה בה'
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"**Ikkar ha'holadah tied to ה**, bechina of **'ha lachem zera'** (Bereshis 47:23). **Avraham + Sarah did not generate offspring until they reached this ה** (Zohar Chadash Shir Ha'Shirim on **'na'avu l'chayayich'**). Ikkar holadah via **da'as** — **'v'ha'adam yada'** (Bereshis 4:1) — **'v'katan eino molid'** (Sanhedrin 68b). Ikkar da'as = **using his da'as** = bringing his sechel **mi'ko'ach el ha'po'al**. A katan has da'as too but it's **b'koach, not b'po'al** — he hasn't used it. One **b'shleimus ha'da'as** is one who brought his da'as to action; only such a person can **molid**."**

intermediate.en: **Holadah tied to ה** ("ha lachem zera," Ber 47:23). Avraham+Sarah no offspring until this ה (Zohar Chadash Shir). Holadah via **da'as** (Ber 4:1 "yada"; San 68b "katan eino molid"). Bring da'as **mi'koach l'po'al**.
intermediate.he: **הולדה תלויה ב־ה** ("הא לכם זרע", בר' מז, כג). אברהם+שרה ללא בנים עד ה זו (זו"ח שה"ש). הולדה ע"י **דעת** (בר' ד, א "ידע"; סנ' סח: "קטן אינו מוליד"). הוצאת דעת **מכוח לפועל**.

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. בר' מז, כג; ד, א; סנ' סח:.

beginner.en: **"To complete da'as (shleimus), only via **engaging with people to bring them close to avodas Hashem**. They sharpen his da'as — **'u'mi'talmidai yosair mi'kulam'** (Makkos 10a). Therefore **talmidim are called banim** (Sifri Ve'eschanan on **'v'shinantam l'vanecha,'** Devarim 6:7) — through them comes holadah."** **"Hence **Avraham and Sarah toiled to make gerim** — by that they **completed their da'as**, reached this ה = da'as Hashem, and merited banim."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus da'as via mekarev → talmidim** (Mak 10a "mi'talmidai yosair"; Sifri Ve'eschanan Dev 6:7 "l'vanecha"=talmidim). Avraham+Sarah=gerim → shleimus da'as → banim.
intermediate.he: **שלמות דעת דרך קירוב → תלמידים** (מכ' י "מתלמידיי יותר"; ספרי ואתחנן דב' ו, ז "לבניך"=תלמידים). אברהם+שרה=גרים → שלמות דעת → בנים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. מכ' י; ספרי ואתחנן; דב' ו, ז.

beginner.en: **R"N bracket**: "Here is a second version I wrote myself, per what I heard, with some additions:"

**"When a person merits **shleimus ha'da'as** — i.e., knows **it is impossible for a person to know more** — there remain **5 bechinos of difference** between a person's shleimus ha'da'as and Hashem's da'as (cited in the books). One must strive to reach this shleimus, so no difference remains except those 5 — which are **impossible for human sechel to attain** unless **one rises above mankind**. Shleimus ha'da'as is reached via **gerim** — Chazal: tzaddikim' acquisitions are through gerim."**

intermediate.en: **Shleimus ha'da'as** = knowing "impossible to know more" — only 5 bechinos remain between human shleimus + Hashem's da'as (5 categories ungraspable by human sechel). Reached via **gerim**.
intermediate.he: **שלמות הדעת** = ידיעה ש"אי אפשר לדעת יותר" — נותרו ה' בחינות הפרש (ה' קטגוריות בלתי נתפסות לאנושי). מושגת ע"י **גרים**.

scholarly.he: ה' בחינות הפרש; שלמות דעת ע"י גרים.
